description: This file contains functions for searching files and directories within a workspace using ripgrep and fzf, including configuration handling and path verification.

methods.name: executeRipgrep
methods.description: Executes ripgrep with specified arguments and returns matching files and directories, limited by a count.

methods.name: getRipgrepSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves additional ripgrep arguments based on VSCode search configuration settings.

methods.name: executeRipgrepForFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all files and directories in the workspace, excluding certain folders, with a limit.

methods.name: searchWorkspaceFiles
methods.description: Searches for files and folders in the workspace matching a query, using fzf for fuzzy matching.
